newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end higher on weaker yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end higher on weaker yen.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed higher across the board on Friday, reflecting the yen's falls against the dollar, traders said.
Prices were 100 to 250 yen higher, with the benchmark November 1997 contract up 150 yen at 13,890 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 41,388 lots.
Local investors hesitated to trade actively in early morning as the Chicago market was closed on Thursday due to the Thanksgoving Day holiday.
But the weaker yen against the dollar encouraged the investors to buy later, traders said.
